prompts.ratel: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a TRUE GAME WALK CYCLE for this reference character gray honey badger with dark gray fur and long cream back mane, no clothes. Reference image only for character design, DO NOT copy its repeated fake walking poses. Exactly EIGHT full-body sprites arranged FOUR COLUMNS x TWO ROWS on real transparent background, equal square cells and generous margins. All face LEFT, strict side view, feet ground baseline same height. This is a professional Richard Williams animator walk study with CONTACT / DOWN / PASS / UP phases, then opposite leg CONTACT / DOWN / PASS / UP. Make all EIGHT leg poses VISIBLY DIFFERENT. Crucial: mark the FAR leg a distinctly darker shade and the NEAR leg the character's normal colour, so swapping legs is clear. FIRST ROW: frame1 NEAR foot stretched forward to LEFT touching heel, FAR leg stretches back to RIGHT; frame2 NEAR support knee bends over grounded flat foot, FAR heel lifts to push off; frame3 NEAR support leg vertical under hips grounded flat foot, FAR knee bent high so FAR foot is visibly lifted behind and passing the planted ankle; frame4 NEAR leg extends back to right toe, FAR knee high forwards to LEFT foot off ground. SECOND ROW: frame5 FAR darker foot stretches forward to LEFT touching heel, NEAR normal-colour foot stretches back RIGHT; frame6 FAR support knee bends flat foot, NEAR heel lifts behind; frame7 FAR support leg vertical under hips grounded flat foot, NEAR knee bent high and NEAR foot clearly off ground passing planted ankle; frame8 FAR leg extends back to right toe, NEAR knee high forwards to LEFT foot off ground. At least one foot grounded in EVERY frame; no jumping. Each passing pose MUST have the feet close together with the swing foot OFF the ground; each contact pose MUST have feet WIDE APART. NOT eight copies of a wide-legged walking stance. Opposite arm swing: near arm back in frame1, near arm forward in frame5. Keep head/body/garment/tail exact identity and proportions with stable root at centre of each cell. Subtle body bob, no size changes or turning towards camera. No floor, no shadows, no text, no props. All ears tails feet completely inside their cells. Output the 4x2 atlas.
